conflictLedger.conflict: The controlling registry contains Rumin commander, general, and city rows, but none of the 18 constructed replacement cards present in the implementation.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Use repository definitions only to illustrate current implementation behavior. Do not change mechanics, claim registry authority, or promote the cards to canon. Mark every constructed asset as implementation-bound pending registry reconciliation.

conflictLedger.conflict: Creative OS uses Kaisar while the current implementation and requested card title use Kaiser.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Treat them as the same Rumin figure for visual continuity, retain current implementation labels, and bake no name or lettering into art.

conflictLedger.conflict: Verified C-09 says Meerus establishes imperial order; the current chapter implementation names Augustus as the first emperor.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: The chapter art depicts the institutional transition to empire and an intentionally non-identifying ruler in republican ceremony. It does not establish Augustus visually or contradict the Meerus trajectory. The content-name mismatch remains visible for a separate governed reconciliation.

conflictLedger.conflict: The available Rumin visual families are Pending Review or Not Canon with rights status Needs Truth; no Rumin asset family is recorded as an approved governing visual identity.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Do not reference those images directly in generation. Derive candidate style from verified written authorities, the user's explicit direction, and the operational Gauntlet visual contract.

globalVisualGrammar.civilization: A sophisticated Naga civic civilization transformed through Roman republican-to-imperial structures and finance-as-infrastructure.
globalVisualGrammar.people: Consistent civilized serpent-bodied citizens with two arms, expressive scaled faces, practical draped garments and segmented civic or military armor; no extra limbs, wings, dragon anatomy, or horror-monster posture.
globalVisualGrammar.architecture: Forums, senate halls, basilicas, banks, vaults, aqueducts, roads, granaries, markets, frontier works, and monumental civic thresholds.
globalVisualGrammar.materials: Warm marble and travertine, dark basalt, hammered bronze, restrained gold leaf, leather, linen, wax seals, ledger tablets, grain, stone roads, and aged red/ochre/verdigris accents.
globalVisualGrammar.style: Premium painterly historical illustration with matte pigments, controlled etched edge texture, strong silhouettes, lived-in civic detail, and restrained cinematic light. Cohesive adjacent pieces; not glossy mobile-game splash art.
mustPreserve: finance as civic transformation rather than modern literalism
Kaisar's generosity and concentrated power as simultaneous truths
institutional wealth rather than treasure piles
readable subject silhouettes at card and thumbnail size
safe central composition for reusable crops
Gauntlet's sharp, tense, readable, game-first presentation
mustAvoid: cyberpunk or modern Wall Street objects
humanoid tree or botanical Sheen traits
Frumo pirate or revolutionary costume language
readable text, fake letters, logos, card frames, UI, rarity labels, or watermarks
malformed anatomy, duplicate figures, nonsensical weapons, cropped focal subjects, or plastic gloss

assets.title: Gilded Scale Legionary

contentFacts.rules: When this attacks after a diamond was paid this turn, it gets +1 value.

assets.factionAuthority: Rumin Roman military and civic-finance transformation; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Republican legion discipline, triumphal gate, paved road, marble, bronze, leather, linen, red-ochre standard cloth without symbols.

assets.factionAuthority: C-09 Roman foundation trajectory and current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Rough early stone, timber scaffolds, nascent forum, road survey, defensive wall, river crossing, dawn earth tones with restrained red cloth.

assets.title: The Republic

contentFacts.story: Generations pass. Rumie grows wealthy, but corrupt senators, banks, runes, and legions begin shaping a fragile republic.

assets.visualSubject: A packed republican forum debates beneath the senate basilica while citizens petition, bankers weigh deposits, legionaries watch, and a narrow stream of wealth quietly enters a senators-only arcade.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 Roman republic as primary skeleton with finance as transformation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Republican senate steps, public rostrum, market stalls, bank counters, marble worn by crowds, bronze scales, civic red and bone.

assets.title: The Jewel

contentFacts.story: Kaiser rises as a beloved officer who walks among workers, pays debts, and exposes a governor protected by the aristocracy.

assets.visualSubject: Young Kaiser walks among workers and debtors in a prosperous but unequal market, publicly paying an obligation and confronting Governor Severan on the steps of a protected jewel-bank enclave.
assets.factionAuthority: Kaisar's generosity and power-building contradiction under C-09; implementation spelling retained without text.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Marble market, jewel-bank grille, bread and oil distribution, wax-sealed debt tablets, officer's civic armor, crowd and elite balcony.

assets.title: The Gaulic Wars

contentFacts.story: Northern tribes unite against Rumie. Kaiser turns frontier war into fame, wealth, and open trade routes.

assets.visualSubject: On a cold northern frontier, Kaiser leads Rumin legions along a newly cut road toward Vercan's united warbands, with forested hills, supply columns, and contested trade routes widening the scene beyond a duel.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 military expansion and Roman structural anchor; current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Mud and stone road works, frontier earthworks, disciplined bronze-and-red legion, varied northern Rumin tribal materials, overcast green-gray light.

assets.title: The Three Runes

contentFacts.story: Kaiser discovers vaults of Strength, Protection, and Experience, then begins binding sacred runes to the legions.

assets.visualSubject: Deep below conquered land, Kaiser enters an ancient stone vault where a non-humanoid guardian stands between him and three distinct geometric relic-stones; waiting legionaries remain small at the threshold.
assets.factionAuthority: Current chapter content bounded by C-09; runes are strategic sacred relics, not generic spell loot.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Pre-Rumie cyclopean stone, bronze vault rings, three restrained luminous forms, dust, old water channels, legion lamps.

assets.title: The First Empire Bank

contentFacts.story: Kaiser returns to build roads, grain systems, public works, and banking reforms while saboteurs try to break Rumie's markets.

assets.visualSubject: Rumie's first empire bank operates as a vast civic system: a basilica bank linked to grain depots, aqueducts, paved roads, clerks, carts, and public queues while a small sabotage attempt is contained at the edge.
assets.factionAuthority: Finance as imperial infrastructure and Kaisar's genuine prosperity/power contradiction under C-09.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Bank basilica, granary arcades, aqueduct, road hub, bronze scales, ledger counters, public works crews, bone marble and verdigris roofs.
mustPreserve: roads, grain, public works, and bureaucracy

assets.title: The Crossing

contentFacts.story: The Senate orders Kaiser to surrender command. Brutus pleads for restraint, but Kaiser marches and civil war begins.

assets.visualSubject: At dusk, Kaiser's legions cross a monumental stone boundary bridge and checkpoint toward Rumie while Brutus remains on the near side and Cassius's Senate force blocks the distant road; the physical threshold makes the political point of no return unmistakable.
assets.factionAuthority: Current chapter's law-versus-loyalty threshold within C-09's fall-of-Republic trajectory; no unapproved named river is invented.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Stone causeway, civic boundary pillars without text, legion column, Senate standards, river gorge, dark red dusk and steel-blue distance.

assets.title: The Last Republic

contentFacts.story: Rumie burns as legions and senators collide. Kaiser wins the city, but Brutus survives the fall of the old order.

assets.visualSubject: Senate Square becomes the final civic battlefield: Kaiser's legions push through broken barricades while Brutus leads the last republican defenders beneath damaged colonnades, with citizens fleeing between institutions both sides claim to save.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 fall of the Republic, morally contradictory power, and current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Senate square, scorched marble, broken rostrum, legion formations, republican civic guards, smoke, ember red against bone stone.
mustPreserve: political collision rather than anonymous war
Kaiser and Brutus embedded in opposing systems

assets.title: Emperor of Gold

contentFacts.story: At Kaiser's peak, roads, banks, and legions flourish, but prisoners, taxes, and central rule make citizens question the jewel.

assets.visualSubject: At Kaiser's imperial peak, one panoramic civic vista holds new roads, strong banks, fed markets, disciplined legions, tax queues, and shadowed prison arches beneath the same golden administration.
assets.factionAuthority: Kaisar's prosperity and concentrated coercion must remain simultaneously legible under C-09.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Imperial forum terrace, road network, bank and granary, regimented columns, restrained gold light, dark basalt prisons and tax counters.
mustPreserve: Kaiser at center but not oversized

assets.title: The Ides of Rumie

contentFacts.story: Kaiser stabilizes the empire, yet the conspiracy reaches the Senate floor. This chapter frames the tragedy more than the victory.

assets.visualSubject: During a public festival inside the Senate Hall, Brutus and the conspirators close around Kaiser in a tragic circular composition while stunned citizens and senators register betrayal; violence is imminent or restrained, not gore-driven.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 requires Kaisar's assassination and preserves the tragedy of generosity, obligation, fear, and concentrated power.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Senate hall, festival greenery and red cloth, marble floor, civic robes, concealed bronze blades, cold daylight from high clerestory.

assets.title: War of the Successors

contentFacts.story: After Kaiser dies, Bobei seeks vengeance while Brutus tries to restore the Republic from the ruins.

assets.visualSubject: In the damaged outskirts of Rumie, Bobei's grieving loyalist army and Brutus's republican survivors converge among broken standards, abandoned debt tablets, refugee carts, and contested roads.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 successor conflict after assassination; current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Ruined civic road, damaged aqueduct, rival legion standards, funeral cloth, field fortifications, muted bronze, ash and winter red.
mustPreserve: Bobei vengeance and Brutus restoration visibly distinct
Kaiser's absence felt through broken standard

assets.title: The First Emperor

contentFacts.story: The victor keeps the bank, legions, and rune program, restores Senate traditions, and leaves Rumie with an empire wearing republican robes.

assets.visualSubject: Rumie's new imperial settlement is staged as a Senate restoration ceremony: an intentionally non-identifying serpent ruler stands in restrained profile behind republican robes and ritual screens while the bank, legions, and three-rune program remain visibly centralized and Bobei's defeated standard is lowered.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 controls the visual trajectory: Meerus ultimately establishes imperial order. The repository's Augustus naming is not promoted through the image.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Restored Senate basilica, republican ceremonial robes, imperial guard geometry, bank counters, three restrained relic forms, bronze and bone with quiet dawn light.
mustAvoid: clear face that settles the unresolved identity mismatch
